entry.title: GAID hub
entry.body: A hub to build skills or Workflows from literature and data, share them and get feedback

home.title: GAID hub
home.body: A hub to build skills or Workflows from literature and data, share them and get feedback
home.empty: No methods yet. Upload a paper PDF or code to start.
home.mine: My skills and Workflows (drafts and registered)
home.catalogueHint: {title} is a catalogue Workflow. Start it from the Workflow panel of a research project.

sources.title: Upload sources
sources.drop: Drop a paper PDF or a code archive (.zip, .tar.gz).
sources.goalPlaceholder: e.g. an exploration method for grid data from another region
sources.noPdfText: The PDF page-text tool is missing, so PDF content cannot be read. You can continue with code or notes.
sources.urlPlaceholder: https://doi.org/… or a web page address
sources.urlNote: The server inside the institute network reads the address and keeps the text with the original.

reading.title: Reading sources
reading.received: {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} received
reading.analysis: Finding the method and missing decisions
reading.note: It continues if you close the screen.
reading.failed: Could not analyze the sources. Run it again.
reading.interrupted: The app restarted and the analysis stopped. Run it again.

questions.title: Answer questions
questions.reviewBody: All answers are applied together to create the draft.
questions.needAll: {count, plural, one {# question has} other {# questions have}} no answer. Answer or choose Decide later.
questions.allApplied: All answers are in the draft. Use "Request changes" on the draft screen to change something.

drafting.title: Creating the draft
drafting.note: Applying {count} answers. It continues if you close the screen.

draft.checkFail: {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} to fix
draft.feedbackPlaceholder: Describe what to change, e.g. compute the variogram on at most 10,000 cells
draft.autoFix: Ask the agent to fix them

trial.title: Try in my research project first (optional)
trial.body: Install the draft into a project, prepare its inputs, then open the Workflow start settings.
trial.consent: I understand the draft skill can run code in the project.
trial.notReady: Fix the issues to try the draft.
trial.none: No trial chat yet. Start a trial from the start settings.
trial.observed: {files, plural, one {# output file} other {# output files}} · {failed, plural, one {# failed tool call} other {# failed tool calls}}
trial.newer: Revision {n} of the draft is new. The tried revision is {installed}.

prep.noWorkflow: The installed method has no Workflow. Open the method from the project's Workflow panel.
prep.title: Inputs for {project}
prep.needInputs: Upload every required input and prepare the run environment to open the start settings.

register.title: Register in the GAID hub
register.notePlaceholder: e.g. Built for grid data from other regions. Please try it and leave feedback.
register.shared: Shared: skill and Workflow files, method flow, check record, trial assessments
register.notShared: Not shared: uploaded paper PDFs, original code archives, research data
register.line: Registered methods can be viewed, starred and discussed by other researchers. Check how it will look first.
register.registeredLine: Revision {n} is registered in the hub.
register.previewBanner: Preview: this is how other researchers will see it in the hub.
register.notYet: The shared hub store is connected after the screens are agreed. Preview only for now.

shared.trials: {count, plural, one {# GAID trial record} other {# GAID trial records}} (not a review)
shared.commentPlaceholder: Write what you found when you tried it, or what to fix.
shared.afterRegister: After registration, other researchers can star it and comment.

user.title: Name in the hub
user.body: Registrations, stars and comments show this name. It is kept in this browser.

overview.gates: {count, plural, one {# researcher decision} other {# researcher decisions}}

visuals.failed: Could not make the concept pictures.
